title: Does Research-Paper Context Improve LLM-Generated Quadruped Navigation? An Exploratory Simulation Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.32381v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models can write competent robot navigation code, but not only does the research on the topic advance, a model may also, due to the volume of findings, fail to recall relevant findings and apply them to the task at hand. In this work, we test whether providing particular research papers as context improves the LLM-written navigation code for the Go2 quadruped, with the LLM (Claude Opus 5) and locomotion policy frozen. Specifically, we compare the navigation controllers the LLM writes when provided with and without particular papers across three settings: behavior trees, navigators edited from a shared base, and controllers written from scratch. When a maze's shortest route is blocked mid-episode, 2 of 8 controllers written with the context of an incremental-replanning paper complete all four trips under Isaac Sim physics, against 7 of 8 without it (two-sided Fisher's exact test, p = 0.041). translated_title: 提供研究论文上下文能否改进大语言模型生成的四足机器人导航？一项探索性仿真研究
translated_abstract: 大语言模型能够编写出合格的机器人导航代码，但由于该领域研究持续进展且成果数量庞大，模型可能无法召回相关研究发现并将其应用于当前任务。在这项工作中，我们测试了提供特定研究论文作为上下文是否能改进大语言模型为 Go2 四足机器人编写的导航代码，其中大语言模型（Claude Opus 5）和运动控制策略均保持冻结。具体而言，我们在三种设置下比较了大语言模型在有和没有特定论文作为上下文时编写的导航控制器：行为树、从共享基础版本编辑的导航器，以及从零开始编写的控制器。当迷宫的最短路径在回合中途被阻断时，以增量重规划论文作为上下文编写的 8 个控制器中仅有 2 个在 Isaac Sim 物理仿真下完成了全部四次行程，而没有该上下文的 8 个控制器中有 7 个完成了任务（双侧 Fisher 精确检验，p = 0.041）。这一差异仅在……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 这项探索性仿真研究发现，为 LLM 提供特定研究论文作为上下文并未改进四足机器人的导航代码，反而在迷宫最短路径中途被阻断的场景下显著降低了生成控制器的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: In an exploratory simulation study, providing specific research papers as context did not improve—and even significantly degraded—the robustness of LLM-generated quadruped navigation controllers when the maze's shortest route was blocked mid-episode.
